asked: # Build: every change goes through a PR, and every PR is brought up to date with main before it merges (Refactor profile, Opus, one session, no sub-agents) NOTE (relaunch Oct 30 2026 13:55 EDT): the first launch stopped because it could not load the rules from axHub. This launch is allowed the axHub tool (mcp__claude_ai_axHub__call, list_services, describe_service, get_job): load CLAUDE.md, the shared rules and THREADS.md through axhub.memory_read (project amberx-axf / shared, area claude), then build. The axHub tool is allowed. Brett, Oct 30 2026 (voice): "I want everything to need a PR and to pull against main before it's merged." Read CLAUDE.md, _claude/shared/rules/RULES.md, _claude/rules/RULES.md and _claude/THREADS.md first. Branch claude/pr-only-merge (this worktree, based on claude/veto-everywhere = PR #176, which adds push banner 0.4.0 auto-merge). Another build (claude/veto-complete) is working on the veto banner/alarm/AmberX: don't touch those files. Build, in the push-banner console plugin (server + web + test.py), version 0.5.0: 1. Every branch gets a PR: each auto-merge round, open a PR (existing open_pr) for every branch in the watched repos that is ahead of main and has no open PR (skip main, site, go-pass, gh-pages, forks, hidden branches). Setting autoPr, on by default, next to the Auto-merge switch. 2. No direct merges: the banner's Merge on a branch without a PR (merge_branch) becomes Open PR; the merge-branch route refuses with a message saying to open a PR. Keep merge-pr.sh working for PRs. 3. Pull main in before merging, one at a time: auto-merge takes ready PRs oldest first. If a PR is behind main (compare main...head behind_by > 0, or mergeable_state behind), pull main in (existing update path, head pinned), then leave it for a later round until CI on the NEW head is green. Merge only when behind_by == 0, mergeable, not draft, CI green on the pinned head. At most one merge per round, so the next PR is updated against the new main. A pull that conflicts goes to the existing Pull failed list / Fix with Claude path. 4. If the GitHub token can set branch protection on main (require a PR, require branches up to date, required status check), set it for the watched repos; if not, add a systems check banner item with Auto fix that explains it. Never weaken existing protection. 5. Tests in test.py for all of the above (auto PR, no direct merge, behind -> pull -> wait -> merge, one merge per round, conflict path). Run test.py, console tsc, check-theme, check-controls, plugin-lifecycle check push-banner. 6. Rules: update _claude/shared/rules/RULES.md ("Automatic merge" rule: every change through a PR, pulled up to date with main and re-tested before merge, no direct merges to main) and the plugins README push-banner line; THREADS.md row; add a build to the Refactor orchestrator (_claude/builds/profiles/refactor/orchestrator.json) and mark it done when finished. Push the branch and open its PR through the push banner. Don't merge. Anything that needs Brett goes out as a veto call with a reason; never poll it.

result.summary: Push banner 0.5.0: autoPr, no direct merges, behind->pull->wait->merge oldest first, one merge per round, branch protection + systems check Auto fix; rules/README/THREADS/orchestrator. Push + PR sent as veto call (job dce3242a).
